title: Appointment Series Same-Day Cancellation Notice Bands
content:
Rate card — notice bands in the same-day cancellation fee on an Appointment Series.

**Rule.** The same-day notice share is 120 percent where the cancellation gave fewer than 2 hours of notice, 110 percent where it gave at least 2 but fewer than 6 hours, and 100 percent where it gave 6 hours or more. The share is read as a percentage of the same-day basis and multiplies it.

**Which cancellation.** The whole hours of notice recorded on the most recent cancellation on the series that carries no minutes late, the one with the latest appointment date.

| Whole hours of notice | Same-day notice share |
|---|---|
| 0 or 1 | 120 percent |
| 2, 3, 4 or 5 | 110 percent |
| 6 or more | 100 percent |

**Edges.** 1 hour takes 120 percent and 2 hours 110 percent; 5 hours takes 110 percent and 6 hours 100 percent.

**Example (hypothetical figures).** A 07:00 call for a 10:00 appointment gives 3 hours of notice: 110 percent of a USD 35.00 basis is USD 38.50.
